_comment: SYNTHETIC RECORDING — NOT A REAL SCANNER RUN. Hand-authored so the harness self-test is deterministic. It deliberately detects 7 of 12 labels and emits one false positive, so the scorecard exercises the hit, miss, and FP paths. Replace with real scanner output before publishing any number derived from it.

findings.message: Tool operator_note returns instruction-shaped text that the tool description labels as trusted, creating a prompt injection sink.
save_report joins a caller-supplied name onto a sandbox path with no confinement check, allowing an unconfined file write.
Resource template report://{path} exempts its path parameter from the SDK path traversal check, enabling arbitrary file read.
find_files exposes an unrestricted glob root with wildcard patterns and advertises whole-filesystem scope in its description.
lookup_user returns unmasked sensitive personal data including a national identifier and payment card number.
delete_file performs an irreversible deletion with no authorization check and no confirmation, and is reachable by an autonomous agent.
install_plugin fetches remote source and loads it with no integrity verification, allowlist, or signature check.
Tool render_greeting reflects caller-supplied input into its response.
